intro: Come along for a gorgeous festive afternoon at Blackpool Cricket Club, supporting small local businesses and getting a head start on your Christmas shopping.

sections.heading: What to expect

Plenty of stalls, with gifting, sweet treats, decorations and more. The stalls are fully sold out, so there will be a full line-up of traders to browse.

intro: An unforgettable night of live music as the P!NK tribute Beautiful Trauma, featuring Stacy Green as P!NK and a full live band, comes to Layton Institute.

sections.heading: The show
sections.html:
A high-energy show celebrating the biggest hits from one of the world's most iconic pop-rock stars. Expect powerhouse vocals, stunning stage presence and all the chart-topping favourites, including Just Like a Pill, Raise Your Glass, So What, Try, Who Knew, Get the Party Started, What About Us and many more.

Whether you are a lifelong P!NK fan or simply love a great live performance, it is packed with energy, singalong anthems and a fantastic atmosphere from start to finish.

sections.heading: Make a night of it
sections.html: Bring your friends, grab a drink from the bar and get ready to sing, dance and party the night away.

sections.heading: Tickets
sections.html: Tickets are £12 in advance or £16 on the door. They are expected to sell quickly, so book early to avoid missing out.

title: Elf Jr. The Musical
summary: AVR present Elf Jr. The Musical at Layton Institute on Sunday 20 and Monday 21 December 2026, 7pm. A festive family show full of songs, dance and Christmas magic.

posters.alt: Poster for AVR presents Elf Jr. The Musical, Sunday 20th December, 7pm, with a green elf boot in a snowy festive scene
Poster for AVR presents Elf Jr. The Musical, Monday 21st December, 7pm, with a green elf boot in a snowy festive scene

facts.label: Performed by
facts.value: AVR

facts.label: Who it's for
facts.value: The whole family

intro: Get ready to spread some Christmas cheer with AVR's magical production of Elf Jr. The Musical, a festive family adventure packed with laughter, singing, dancing and plenty of Christmas magic.

sections.heading: The story
sections.html: Based on the much-loved Christmas film, Elf Jr. The Musical tells the hilarious and heartwarming story of Buddy, a young orphan who mistakenly crawls into Santa's sack and is transported to the North Pole. Raised as an elf, Buddy soon discovers he is actually human and sets off on an unforgettable journey to New York City to find his real father and discover where he truly belongs.

sections.heading: The show
sections.html: With catchy songs, fantastic dance routines, colourful characters and lots of festive fun, the talented AVR performers are ready to bring this Christmas favourite to life on stage. Bring the whole family and get into the Christmas spirit.

sections.heading: Tickets
sections.html: There are two performances, on Sunday 20 and Monday 21 December, both at 7pm. Standard tickets are £12 and concession tickets (over 60 and under 16) are £10. Book early, as tickets are likely to go quickly.
